label: pjm 71 coal bit
definition: PJM 71 coal-bit-floor 0.65 (bracket bisect): floor=0.75 overshot (COAL_BIT -8/-13 TWh under). Bisecting the 0.55-0.75 bracket at 0.65 to find the floor that best splits C1-coal-volume and C3a-price. Sigmoid: floor=0.65, ceil=1.32, gas_mid=3.40, gas_slope=2.5. All other settings pjm-70 verbatim (reserve co-opt ON).
